INT. STUDIO TAKE 01
The Story

Third-year CS student, full-stack developer, occasional director of small businesses' first real website.

I'm a Computer Science student at the Lebanese University, and for the last few years I've been turning class assignments and client briefs into actual, deployed products — not just demos. I work across the stack: Java and PHP on the backend, React and modern JavaScript up front, MySQL underneath.

I care less about chasing whatever framework is trending and more about whether the person using the site can actually get what they came for. Outside of freelance work, I co-run Weblume, a small studio where we build websites for businesses that just need something that works — and looks like them.
